status: experimental bounded synthetic subset, not full IAM or Organizations coverage
source_operation_verification: verified in official AWS API documentation; no request made
permission_verification: unverified least-privilege IAM authorization policy in this session; no policy installed
pagination: require IsTruncated=false after caller materializes all Marker pages

mappings.target: principal(human_user), direct GroupList membership, explicitly supplied credential metadata
principal(group), inline GroupPolicyList and AttachedManagedPolicies; IAM groups do not nest
principal(workload_identity or explicit synthetic ai_agent classification), RolePolicyList, AttachedManagedPolicies, bounded account-root trust
exactly one default managed policy version; URL-decoded RFC3986 JSON accepted
allow or subtractive deny bindings against explicit finite resource-operation catalog; Action/NotAction and Resource/NotResource
can_assume only when account-root trust and caller identity permission both allow and neither explicitly denies; other trust forms rejected

unsupported: resource policies beyond account-root role trust
